data.description: Enjoy an opulent and holistic lifestyle in The Heights Country Club & Wellness community.

strapiAreaGuide.title: The Heights Country Club and Wellness

data.answer:
Developed with meticulous attention to detail by Emaar Properties, this enclave presents an unparalleled lifestyle experience.

The community's emphasis on wellness is evident throughout, with thoughtfully curated amenities designed to promote physical, mental, and emotional well-being. From state-of-the-art fitness centers and spa facilities to serene green spaces and jogging tracks, every aspect of life at The Heights is geared towards fostering a healthy and balanced lifestyle.

The upscale resort project houses 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses and 4-bedroom semi-detached villas with breathtaking views of the resort. The Heights Country Club and Wellness townhouses will also feature amenities like large balconies, floor-to-ceiling windows, a swimming pool, and plenty of open spaces.

more_info.question: What is Life Like at The Heights Country Club and Wellness?

data.answer:
It will be a picturesque location with beautifully landscaped grounds, walking trails, and parks. This promotes an outdoor lifestyle with activities like hiking, biking, and golf.

Public Transportation in The Heights Country Club and Wellness Community

Buses and metro stations are a little away from the community. Dubai Investment Park Metro Station is about 20 minutes away from The Heights Country Club and Wellness. However, the area is well-connected with Emirates Road (E611), making it easier for residents to commute in and around the area.

Supermarkets Near The Heights Country Club and Wellness 

Carrefour Market and Geant Supermarket are currently the closest choices for Remraam residents. However, as the community reaches full development, an array of options will emerge within the vicinity, providing residents with convenient access to their daily necessities and grocery needs.

Malls Near The Heights Country Club and Wellness

There will be various retail outlets in the community once it is established. Currently, the nearest shopping malls are City Centre Me'aisem and Ibn Battuta Mall. The area is about 18 minutes from Marina Mall. It is a premier shopping and entertainment destination in Dubai. It features a wide array of international retail brands, dining options, and leisure activities, making it a popular spot for both locals and tourists alike.

Schools and Nurseries Near The Heights Country Club and Wellness

You can find three schools inside the community. Near The Heights Country Club and Wellness, residents have access to several educational institutions, ensuring families have quality options for their children's schooling and early education. Fairgreen International School is conveniently located approximately 15 minutes away, offering a robust international curriculum focused on environmental sustainability. A bit further, Ranches Primary School is around 16 minutes from the community, known for its nurturing environment and strong primary educational programs. South View School Dubai, about 25 minutes away, provides another excellent option for comprehensive education from early years to the secondary level.

For younger children, there are also notable nurseries nearby. Cherry Tree Nursery in Town Square is just 11 minutes away, providing a warm and engaging early learning environment. Chubby Cheeks Nursery, although a bit farther at 27 minutes, offers a diverse and inclusive setting for early childhood development, emphasizing a holistic approach to learning. These educational facilities ensure that families in The Heights have convenient access to quality education from nursery to higher grades.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques Near The Heights Country Club and Wellness

The area will soon become home to various places for worship. Currently, the closest mosque to the area is Town Square Mosque, at 11 minutes driving distance. Also, Hussein Ali Yateem Mosque is located about 27 minutes away.

Due to its proximity to Jebel Ali, The Heights Country Club, and Wellness community offers easy access to various places of worship. For Christian residents, the St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church provides a place for worship and community activities. Hindu community members can visit the Shiva Temple, a spiritual center for devotees. Additionally, the Gurunanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara is available for Sikh residents, offering a space for prayer and community gatherings.

Clinics And Hospitals Near The Heights Country Club and Wellness 

The Heights Country Club and Wellness community will soon be home to two hospitals. Moreover, it is conveniently located near several hospitals and clinics, ensuring residents have access to excellent healthcare services. Right Health Al Azhar Clinic's Jebel Ali branch and Access Clinic Jafza are nearby facilities that provide primary healthcare services and emergency care, catering effectively to the day-to-day medical needs of the community. 

For more specialized medical treatments, residents can turn to American Hospital Mira Clinic and Fakeeh University Hospital. Both establishments are renowned for their high standards of care and offer a wide range of medical specialties. This accessibility to a variety of healthcare options ensures that residents of The Heights Country Club and Wellness have their health and wellness needs thoroughly met within proximity.

Location & Nearby Areas

The community is next to another announced project by Emaar Properties, Grand Polo Club and Resort. Conveniently situated near Expo Road and Emirates Road, The Heights offers swift access to Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC), reachable within a brief 10-minute drive. Jebel Ali, a vital nexus for economic and commercial ventures in the emirate, is a mere 15-minute drive away. Furthermore, Dubai Marina's picturesque coastline is accessible within a 20-minute drive.

more_info.question: Things to do in The Heights Country Club and Wellness

data.answer:
There will be so many things to do for the residents of The Heights Country Club and Wellness. Residents will have access to top-notch facilities, including state-of-the-art fitness centers, spa services, swimming pools, and sports courts. You can also find an open-air cinema and a central retail plaza in the community. 

The Heights Country Club and Wellness Restaurants and Bars

The area will be home to amazing dining places, offering residents plenty of choices. There will be 40,000 sq. m. of retail-organic dining places. The Heights Country Club and Wellness community is located near a variety of dining options that cater to different tastes and preferences. For those who enjoy grilled cuisine, Grills and More Restaurant in DIP 2 offers a delightful selection of grilled dishes in a cozy setting. Nearby, the Eat and Drink Restaurant offers a diverse menu and casual dining experience. 

For residents looking for a more vibrant atmosphere, the area also boasts several bars and pubs. Crafty Fox Gastro Pub and Sports Bar is a perfect spot for sports enthusiasts looking to enjoy a game night accompanied by great food and drinks, while Crystal Bar offers a sophisticated environment to unwind with an impressive selection of beverages.

Beaches Near The Heights Country Club and Wellness 

The Heights Country Club and Wellness community is conveniently situated near several beautiful beaches, offering residents leisurely escapes to the shore. Pine Beach and Sufouh Beach are among these nearby coastal retreats, each providing a serene environment perfect for relaxing, swimming, and enjoying a variety of water sports. These beaches enhance the living experience at The Heights, adding a picturesque and refreshing outdoor element to the luxurious lifestyle.

Hotels Near The Heights Country Club and Wellness

Those looking for hospitality options can find various hotels nearby. Some of the top options are:

Premier Inn Dubai Investments Park: This hotel is known for its comfortable accommodations and excellent service at a reasonable price. It offers modern amenities such as a swimming pool, a restaurant, and free Wi-Fi, making it a popular choice for both business and leisure travelers.

Courtyard by Marriott Dubai, Green Community: Located near Dubai Investment Park, this hotel provides a more upscale lodging experience with well-appointed rooms, fine dining options, and comprehensive conference facilities. It is suitable for those seeking a luxurious stay.

Aloft Me'aisem, Dubai: This hotel offers a trendy, youthful vibe with stylish rooms, a vibrant social scene, and technology-friendly services. It is ideal for travelers looking for a boutique hotel experience.

Attractions Near The Heights Country Club and Wellness

The Heights Country Club and Wellness community, being in a prime location, offers convenient access to several prominent tourist attractions in Dubai:

Dubai Marina: This bustling area is known for its luxurious yachts, high-rise apartments, and many dining and entertainment options. Dubai Marina Walk, lined with cafes and shops, is perfect for strolls.

The Palm Jumeirah: An iconic artificial archipelago, Palm Jumeirah is home to upscale hotels, residences, and attractions like the Atlantis The Palm. It's a hub for water sports and beach activities.

Ain Dubai: Located on Bluewaters Island, Ain Dubai is the world's largest observation wheel, providing spectacular views of Dubai’s coastline and landmarks.

One minor disadvantage of living in The Heights Country Club and Wellness could be its relatively remote location compared to the city center. This might mean longer travel times for residents when commuting to central Dubai for work or accessing some of the city's major attractions and commercial areas. Although the community provides a tranquil and luxurious living environment, the distance could be a slight inconvenience for those who frequently need to travel t the heart of the city.

more_info.question: FAQS About The Heights Country Club and Wellness Emaar

data.answer:
Where is The Heights Country Club and Wellness Location Emaar?

The community is located near Al Yalayis Street Dubai, close to Dubai Investment Park and Al Maktoum International Airport.

The Heights Country Club and Wellness community will offer a wide range of amenities aimed at promoting a healthy and luxurious lifestyle. Residents can enjoy access to a state-of-the-art fitness center, spa facilities, swimming pools, and various sports courts. data.content:
The Heights Country Club & Wellness is an upcoming resort project by Emaar Properties. It is set along Al Yalayis Street (D57) and features world-class amenities. The new district is close to areas like Dubai Investment Park and Remraam.

The off-plan community spans an expansive 81 million sq. ft. area. It comprises villas and townhouses amidst an array of recreational and leisure attractions.

Al Maktoum International Airport is also located near the community. With plans to transform DWC into the world's largest airport, we expect to see growing attraction and demand for The Heights Country Club and Wellness, just like in the other areas near the airport.

nodes.title: Salva
nodes.about:
Salva at The Heights Country Club & Wellness introduces a villa-only residential setting where architecture, landscape, and lifestyle are seamlessly integrated. The development comprises 3, 4 and 5-bedroom villas arranged across a green master plan, with each home benefiting from ample built-up areas and private outdoor spaces. The community layout promotes movement, restoration, and privacy, positioning the project as a distinctive residential offering within Emaar’s broader portfolio.

Salva at The Heights' amenities include wellness facilities, sports courts, pools, children’s play areas, and landscaped communal zones designed to support family-oriented living. Planned with long-term residency in mind, Salva Dubai luxury residences combine functional layouts with a calm, nature-forward environment, making the project particularly suited to end-users and investors focused on stable appreciation rather than short-term speculation.

nodes.title: Serro
nodes.about:
Serro at The Heights Dubai is a refined villa enclave by Emaar Properties, set within the forest-inspired master community of The Heights Country Club & Wellness. Designed for modern families and long-term homeowners, Serro 1 & Serro 2 offer a curated collection of 3 to 5-bedroom villas that balance architectural elegance with everyday well-being.

Surrounded by landscaped gardens, wellness lakes, and shaded walking trails, the community places nature and balance at the center of daily life. Each villa features generous layouts, contemporary finishes, and seamless indoor-outdoor living, creating a calm and private residential environment. Located in Dubai’s emerging growth corridor near Al Maktoum International Airport, Serro The Heights by Emaar combines long-term location strength with a wellness-led lifestyle, making it ideal for both end-users and investors seeking lasting value.
